stem: During a profile review, a pharmacy filed a serious-event report three years ago and plans to purge the supporting file. What should it do?

choices.text: Purge the file after two years under the general prescription-record rule.
Retain the readily retrievable supporting records for at least five years from filing.
Keep only the submitted report and destroy supporting records.
Measure five years from the dispensing date rather than filing.
Transfer the file to the Board and retain no pharmacy copy.

explanation.core_reasoning: 'Retain the readily retrievable supporting records for at least five years from filing.' is the governing result. By contrast, 'Purge the file after two years under the general prescription-record rule.' would require that the special five-year serious-event retention rule did not control. The decisive cue appears in 'During a profile review, a pharmacy filed a serious-event report three years ago and plans to purge the supporting file. What should it do?'.

choice_analysis.A: 'Purge the file after two years under the general prescription-record rule.' would apply only if the special five-year serious-event retention rule did not control; 'During a profile review, a pharmacy filed a serious-event report three years ago and plans to purge the supporting file. What should it do?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.B: 'Retain the readily retrievable supporting records for at least five years from filing.': supported by record retention.
choice_analysis.C: 'Keep only the submitted report and destroy supporting records.' would apply only if 247 CMR 20.02 required no readily retrievable supporting material; 'During a profile review, a pharmacy filed a serious-event report three years ago and plans to purge the supporting file. What should it do?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.D: 'Measure five years from the dispensing date rather than filing.' would apply only if the retention period began at the medication event; 'During a profile review, a pharmacy filed a serious-event report three years ago and plans to purge the supporting file. What should it do?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.E: 'Transfer the file to the Board and retain no pharmacy copy.' would apply only if submission shifted all retention responsibility away from the pharmacy; 'During a profile review, a pharmacy filed a serious-event report three years ago and plans to purge the supporting file. What should it do?' states otherwise.

related_facts: A pharmacy must retain readily retrievable records relating to reportable improper dispensing and serious adverse drug events for at least five years from filing the report.
